claim_review: Exact source pack and owner-confirmed EU labels reviewed; distinct construction and material facts only. Formal SKU matrix used for color-by-color listed sizes, including gaps and lining variants. No unknown-material headline, tested performance, stock guarantee or unverified fit promise. Other fields preserved.
highlights:
Wide toe-box textured lace-up walking shoes in mesh-lined and plush-lined versions. An EVA outsole supports one casual silhouette with two interior choices.
Listed assortment: Black Mesh Lining: EU 39–48; Black Plush Lining: EU 39–48.

faq.question: Which color and EU size combinations are listed?
faq.answers: Black Mesh Lining: EU 39–48; Black Plush Lining: EU 39–48.

faq.question: How should I choose the lining version?
faq.answers: Choose the mesh-lined version for the regular interior or the plush-lined version for a lined interior. State the lining choice separately in your sample and bulk assortment request.

faq.question: What is the sole material?
faq.answers: This style uses an EVA outsole for this style.

faq.question: What should I check during a sample fitting?
faq.answers: Try the sample with the socks you intend to wear. Assess toe space, heel fit and the upper closure before setting your bulk EU size assortment.

faq.question: What is the minimum order for the original style?
faq.answers: The original-style wholesale minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; custom branding and packaging are quoted separately.

faq.question: How can I arrange a sample?
faq.answers: Request a sample quotation with your preferred color, EU size and lining version and delivery postcode. The quotation includes the sample charge, shipping cost and proposed dispatch schedule.

faq.question: What should I send for a branding or packaging proposal?
faq.answers: Send your logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. We can review the brief for this style and provide a proposal with the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.

faq.question: How can I get a delivered quotation?
faq.answers: Send the color-size quantities and destination postcode or port, plus any packaging request. The quotation separates product cost from freight and sets out the dispatch plan and estimated transit time for your chosen shipping method.
